player_prompt.intro:
Tadakkest daɣ Slitherlink ɣef {R}x{C} azala!
Aɣezz aɣalan n uzuɣer d aɣellaw n tɣimit, iɣ akk tɣimit timḍebber tinɣaɣen iɣellawen.
Isekcem tɣellawen s:
  [h r c] - isekkem tɣellawt taɣerdayt iɣellawen n tɣimit ɣef uzuɣer r, tamḍebburt c
  [v r c] - isekkem tɣellawt tazelmaɣt tɣellawen n tɣimit ɣef uzuɣer r, tamḍebburt c
Tinɣaɣen tinaqqan tinɣaɣen iɣellawen, '.' annect-aɣlan n war tɣimit.
Tellaɣ-d akk {max_turns} n tɣellawin i wakken ad tedduɣ tɣimit.
